summary: A Waybar module that shows the 1-minute system load average with two decimals, colored amber above 2.00 and red above 4.00, refreshed every 5 seconds, with a tooltip carrying the 5-minute and 15-minute load averages.
targetUsers: Linux desktop users running Waybar who want a glanceable system load indicator
goals: Show the 1-minute load average with two decimals in the bar label
Color the label amber above 2.00 and red above 4.00
Show the 5-minute and 15-minute load averages in the tooltip
nonGoals: Historical load charts or long-term logging
Notifications or alerts on high load

features.name: Load average reading
features.userOutcome: The bar shows the current 1-minute load average with two decimals, colored by the stated limits, and the tooltip carries the 5-minute and 15-minute averages.
features.trigger: The service loop refreshes every 5 seconds, and a manual refresh action can be requested.
features.behavior: Each refresh reads the system load average source, takes the 1-minute, 5-minute, and 15-minute values, and writes them with the sample instant to the single stored reading record. The label is the 1-minute value formatted with exactly two decimals; the class is critical when the 1-minute value is strictly above 4.00, warning when strictly above 2.00, and normal otherwise. The tooltip shows the 5-minute and 15-minute values, each with two decimals. The module command with no action only re-reads the cached label; a reading reaches the bar at the next fragment re-run after the cache write. When no reading was ever stored the label is -- with class empty.
features.failureOutcome: When the load average cannot be read, the cache keeps the last good label text with class stale, the module output rendered from that cache is that text with STALE_SUFFIX appended and class stale, and no stored record changes.
acceptanceSignals: After a successful refresh with a 1-minute load of 1.25, the cached label text is 1.25 with class normal.
A 1-minute load of 2.50 yields class warning and a load of 4.50 yields class critical.
The stored reading record holds the 1-minute, 5-minute, and 15-minute values and the sample instant.
The tooltip text contains the 5-minute and 15-minute values each formatted with two decimals.
With no stored reading the module output is -- with class empty.
After a failed refresh the module output is the last good label text with STALE_SUFFIX appended and class stale.

dataObjects.name: Load reading
dataObjects.purpose: Keeps the latest load average sample so the label and tooltip can be rendered from stored data.
dataObjects.retentionIntent: Only the latest sample is kept; each refresh replaces the single stored row.

qualityRequirements: The 1-minute, 5-minute, and 15-minute values are each shown with exactly two decimals.
The label class is normal, warning, critical, stale, or empty and never any other value.
productConstraints: The module runs inside Waybar and refreshes on a 5-second service interval.
The label is derived from the cache; stored records are the source of the tooltip detail.
